title: TryHackMe Machine: Orion Walkthrough
title_si: TryHackMe Orion Machine පියවරෙන් පියවර විසඳුම
author: Pho3o
synopsis: Orion is a very easy Linux machine featuring CSRF Validation Bypass and exploitation of CraftCMS and Telnetd. Foothold is achieved via CVE-2025-32432 in CraftCMS, yielding remote code execution. Default Craft .env file exposes MySQL DB credentials with a crackable password. Password reuse leads to SSH user access. Finally, privilege escalation is achieved via telnetd (CVE-2026-24061) allowing authentication bypass directly to root.
synopsis_si: Orion යනු CraftCMS සහ Telnetd දුර්වලතා සහිත Very Easy Linux Machine එකකි. මෙහිදී CVE-2025-32432 මගින් CraftCMS තුළින් RCE ලබාගෙන, .env ගොනුවෙන් MySQL දත්ත ලබාගැනීමෙන් පරිශීලක SSH access ලබාගනී. ඉන්පසු telnetd හි CVE-2026-24061 දුර්වලතාවය මගින් Authentication Bypass කර Root බලතල ලබාගනී.

phases.description: Port scanning reveals SSH (port 22) and HTTP (port 80). Web enumeration discloses CraftCMS version 4.4.14.
Exploiting CSRF validation bypass and arbitrary code execution in CraftCMS to get a reverse shell as www-data.
Enumerating /var/www/craftcms/.env exposes DB credentials. Querying MySQL users table reveals admin password hash. Cracking gives SSH credentials for local user.
commands: mysql -u craftuser -p -e 'USE craft; SELECT username, password FROM users;'

phases.description: Internal netstat scan reveals telnetd running on localhost port 23. Exploiting CVE-2026-24061 authentication bypass allows logging in directly as root without a password.

title: TryHackMe Machine: Abducted Walkthrough
title_si: TryHackMe Abducted Machine පියවරෙන් පියවර විසඳුම
author: TheCyberGeek & kavigihan
synopsis: Abducted is a medium Linux machine built around the on-premise file and print server of a professional-services firm. The Samba installation is vulnerable to a print-subsystem command injection (CVE-2026-4480): unescaped print job names submitted over spooler yield code execution. Rclone password is recovered and reused for SSH. Samba share with force user and wide links writes SSH key, and polkit Samba service drop-in executes commands as root.
synopsis_si: Abducted යනු Samba Print-Subsystem (CVE-2026-4480) Command Injection දුර්වලතාවය සහිත Medium Linux Machine එකකි. Rclone password decode කිරීම, Samba wide links හරහා SSH Key ලිවීම සහ Polkit service drop-in මගින් Root බලතල ලබාගැනීම මෙහි අඩංගු වේ.

phases.description: Nmap discovers Samba SMB ports (139/445) and Print Spooler service open.

phases.phase: 2. Foothold: Samba Print Subsystem Command Injection (CVE-2026-4480)
phases.description: Crafting a malicious print job name containing command injection payload sent over spooler protocol yields reverse shell as printer service account.
Finding rclone configuration file. Using rclone obscure to decode stored credentials to gain SSH login.

phases.phase: 4. Privilege Escalation via Samba Wide Links & Polkit Drop-in
phases.description: Abusing writable Samba share with wide links to write ~/.ssh/authorized_keys for another user. Abusing polkit delegated Samba service management to drop a systemd service unit executing commands as root.

title: TryHackMe Machine: Nexus Walkthrough
title_si: TryHackMe Nexus Machine පියවරෙන් පියවර විසඳුම
author: TheCyberGeek & k1ph4ru
synopsis: Nexus is an easy-difficulty Linux machine featuring an exposed Gitea repository leaking credentials and a job posting revealing valid usernames. Leaked credentials give access to Krayin CRM (CVE-2026-38526), leading to shell as www-data. Further enumeration reveals SSH credentials. Gitea template sync service vulnerable to directory traversal is leveraged to gain a root shell.
synopsis_si: Nexus යනු Exposed Gitea Repository එකකින් credentials කාන්දු වීම සහ Krayin CRM (CVE-2026-38526) මගින් www-data shell එකක් ලබාගන්නා Easy Machine එකකි. අනතුරුව Krayin config වෙතින් SSH access ලබාගෙන, Gitea template sync directory traversal මගින් Root බලතල ලබාගනී.
skills_learned: Template Sync Directory Traversal to Root

phases.description: Nmap discovers port 80 (HTTP) and port 3000 (Gitea). Browsing public commits reveals developer credentials.
Authenticating to Krayin CRM and exploiting CVE-2026-38526 file upload / RCE.
Enumerating database and environment configs in /var/www/html/krayin/.env yields cleartext credentials.

phases.phase: 4. Privilege Escalation via Gitea Template Sync Directory Traversal
phases.description: A root cron job executes Gitea template synchronization using unsanitized directory paths. Leveraging directory traversal to overwrite root SSH keys.

title: TryHackMe Machine: What's Your Name Walkthrough
title_si: TryHackMe What's Your Name Machine විසඳුම
author: Farid Hajiyev
synopsis: Comprehensive walkthrough solving the medium-level 'What's Your Name' TryHackMe room. Features port 80/8081 enumeration, hidden directory fuzzing (/api, /public/html), XSS payload execution, CSRF attack chaining for administrative privilege elevation, and full defensive remediation.
synopsis_si: What's Your Name යනු XSS සහ CSRF ප්‍රහාර එකිනෙක සම්බන්ධ කර (Chaining) Admin බලතල ලබාගන්නා Medium මට්ටමේ TryHackMe Room එකකි. Port 80/8081 scanning, directory fuzzing සහ ආරක්ෂණ පියවර මෙහි අඩංගු වේ.

phases.description: Scanning reveals ports 22, 80, and 8081 open. Hosts file mapping to worldwap.thm.
Fuzzing discovers hidden paths /public, /public/html, and /api on port 80.
User profile submission is vulnerable to Stored XSS. The injected JavaScript triggers an administrative CSRF action to promote the attacker's account to admin privileges.
Logging in as administrator, retrieving the flags, and implementing Anti-CSRF tokens with CSP.
